tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i dris lan yod// swasti/ dge legs bsod nams bye ba'i dpal ldan zhing / /zhing 'dir snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon gyur gang / /gang zhig kun dga'i legs bshad ston pa'i mchog /mchog gsum gus pas grub pa'i sa mnyes pa/ /rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po gang de yis/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /the tshom cung zad bri ba'i don po la/ /bla ma'i phyag len gsung rgyun bri bar bya/ /de la don tshan drug zhar byung dang bdun gyi/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i gshang bug g.yas nas 'thon pa'i hūm̐ bsgril ma de/ gcig zhe sdang rdo rje bskyed pa'i sa bon yin kyang / gcig nam mkhar yod pa de dgos pa ji ltar gleng ba/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ sngon po thabs shes rab gnyis med gsal la ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo de ka yin/ dri ba gnyis pa khro bcu sbyor mtshams nas spros bka' bsgo zhes pa la/ sgrub thabs rgyas par lag pa'i rigs lnga yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams yin rgyu ba dang / lhan skyes su gtso bo yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams yin par gsung ba gang 'thad zhes pa sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i skabs su/ lag pa g.yas g.yon byin gyi rlabs/ sor mo rnams rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed nas thal mo sbyar ba'i rkyen gyi/ yab yum snyoms 'jug bskul ba'i sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ lag mthil gyi hūm̐ dang a la thim zhes pa'i khro bo bcu la bka' bsgo ba yin/ yang snying lhan skyes/ bsnyen bsgrub gsal byed sogs sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnams su lag pa byin rlabs med par/ rang skad cig gi gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas khro bo bcu spros pa de la bka' bsgo ba yin pas/ rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba lags/ dri ba gsum pa khro bo bcu'i 'khor lo la sbubs can du byas nas/

khro bo sbubs nang du bzhugs/ sbub med byas na 'khor lo'i rtsibs stengs su bzhugs/ rtsibs stengs su bzhugs na/ steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis la 'khor lo'i sdod tshul dang / khro bo'i bzhugs sa ji ltar byed ces pa/ 'khor lo sbubs can du byed rgyu yin zhing / tshig gi dngos bstan la'ang / steng phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs dbus bzhugs/ /zhes pas thon/ dri ba bzhi pa/ gdan gyi skabs su a tsant+ra maṇḍa la/ zhes zla gdan yod kyang / bris 'bur la zla gdan byed dam gsung ba/ sngon gyi bris sku rnying pa 'dra la bris yong gi 'dug na'ang / deng sang bzo rig pa'i bsla bcos dang / zhal bkod pa rnams thugs g.yengs che bas chad yong gi 'dug don la cis kyang byed dgos rgyu yin/ dri ba lnga pa/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha sogs kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren 'di/ gtso bo yab yum gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa yin nam/ gtso bo yab yum rkyang pa'i ye shes pa yin bya ba/ da lan gyi ye shes pa 'di ni/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gtso bo yab yum rkyang pa'i yin/ dkyil 'khor gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa thun mong yongs rdzogs kyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ 'khor ba phur bu'i skabs su byed/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i dpe tsam la phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la/ sku gzugs byin rlabs chad pa zhig yongs kyi 'dug rung / gsung rgyun phyag len la/ bde bar gshegs pa khyed ci 'dra/ /zhes pa'i 'jug gi oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa'i mjug tu sgo ma bzhi'i dgug gzhug byas rjes/ sngar bzhin sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku sogs sku gzugs byin rlabs kyi tshig brjod dgos rgyu yin/ dri ba drug pa/ phur bsrung dam can bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog re re bzhin bris bsgom la ji ltar byed ces pa dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa'i yul ni/

dam can gyi snam bu'i mtshams bzhir/ khrag mtsho'i steng byang shar du bdag nyid ma re ma ti/ shwa na ma khyi gdong ma/ sa bdag ma rdo rje ya byin/ de bzhin du mtshams gzhan rnams su'ang spel nas bsgom/ sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ bdud kyi bu mo rdo rje ya byin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon phur bu 'dril zhing ral pa mthing nag mun ltar gtib nas/ 'brug sngon la zhon pa/ gza'i bu mo rdo rje de byin sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i zhags pa/ g.yon phur bu 'dril zhing ral pa ser nag rting par sleb pa/ chu srin la zhon pa/ btsan gyi bu mo rdo rje bse byin sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon phur bu 'dril zhing / ral pa dmar nag can/ glog dmar 'khyug la zhon pa/ klu'i bu mo rdo rje phag byin sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dril bu/ g.yon phur bu 'dril zhing ral pa ljang nag can/ klu ra sngon po la zhon pa/ bzhi ka'i ral pa'i rtse la phur bu yod pa'o/ /mngon rtogs dang bstun na/ nam za ber chen mthing nag ser nag dmar nag ljang nag gsol ba/ bdud rta nag po/ gza' rta ser po/ btsan rta dmar po/ klu rta sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin zhon pa/ phyag mtshan yang g.yas pa rnams lcags kyu g.yon pa phur bur bshad pas gang bde bya/ de rnams ni sa bdag ma bzhi yin/ re ma ti sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas me long dang sbrul zhags/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu 'dril zhing dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ re ma ti sku mdog ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas g.yu'i zor ba/ g.yon gser gyi sgrom bu/ rma bya'i sgro thul gsol ba/ shwa ba yu mo la zhon pa/ re ma dza sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas bandha thod pa lcang lo can khrag bskang / g.yon lcags kyu/ sku la re lde gsol ba/

chu glang nag po zhon pa/ re ma dzu sku mdog ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas khram shing / g.yon tshon skud lnga'i gru gu mthing nag dar gyi chu 'phyangs can/ rnga mo gwa pa la zhon pa/ bzhi ka ral pa mthing nag can te bdag nyid ma bzhi'o/ /lcags kyi mi mo lcang gu'i gdong can phyag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon phur bu 'dril ba/ gcer bu ral gcig ma dar gyi cod paṇa can/ lcags kyi lcang mo mgo dgu la zhon pa/ mi mo ser mo 'phar ba'i gdong can/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon phur bu/ gcer bu ral gcig ma dar gyi cod paṇa can/ gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la zhon pa/ zangs kyi mi mo wa'i gdong can phyag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon phur bu 'dril ba/ gcer bu ral gcig ma dar gyi cod pan can/ zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la zhon pa/ g.yu'i mi mo khyi'i gdong pa can phyag g.yas zhing ……mi ro chung zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon phur bu 'dril ba/ gcer bu ral gcig ma dar gyi cod paṇa can/ g.yu'i khyi mo ral can la zhon pa ste shwa na ma bzhi'o/ /dam can/ bcu gnyis kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan bris bsgom gnyis ka la 'di ltar byed/ zhar byung gi dri ba bdun pa/ sne gdong rtse'i thang ga zhing khams ma phal cher la/ phra phyag bstod pa bzhin zhon pa dang bcas bri bar 'dug pa ji ltar lags zer ba/ zhing khams ma rang la 'gal ba cher mi 'dug gzhan dkyil thang sogs bri cha la zhon pa med pa thob rgyu yin/ bstod pa'i skabs su zhon pa 'byung ba dgra gegs la bskul ba'i tshig yin pas/ gnas de nas gzhan du 'gro bar byas pa'o/ /zhes pa'i dri lan bsdus pa 'di/ /sa lo kun dga'i mtshan can gyis/ /zhabs rdul spyi bos gus len pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang pos dge/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ stong ra chos rje kun dga' legs grub pa'i dris lan/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
